name: diffdeck
description: The inbox for code you haven't shipped yet. Every local git repo you juggle, on one page: branch, uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, nested repos. Read-only.
author: Deepak Thomas

scripts.release: npm version patch -m "Release %s" && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "Release %s" && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "Release %s" && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:beta: npm version prerelease --preid beta -m "Release %s" && npm publish --tag beta && git push --follow-tags
